column1: # The server and the docs this engine's committed answers come from.
# default records the tapes: Oracle Database 23ai Free, release 23.26.3
# oracle/parser/testdata/compat.tsv at the same 23.26.3 release so a judge
# revision bump rejudges compat.tsv without touching the default-pinned tapes.
# parser judge revision 4 runs the judge with MAX_STRING_SIZE=EXTENDED, adds
# TYPE (y/w) and DIMENSION (d/e) fixture objects, adds offset-preserving
# stand-ins (ALTER TYPE, ALTER DIMENSION, INMEMORY JOIN GROUP, CREATE PLUGGABLE
# DATABASE USING/SOURCE_FILE_DIRECTORY, SHARING, CREATE PFILE, NO DELETE UNTIL,
# UNTIL TIME, AUDIT POLICY, missing schema a.), adds end-of-statement checks
# docs is the syntax OracleDocs.g4 is converted from: the statement pages of the
# SQL Language Reference oracle/parser/bnf/ quotes, the SHA-256 of what
# oracle/parser/cmd/docsgrammar reads of them, and the date they were quoted.
# columns: role, image, digest, source tag, judge revision
